mean_cn: n.影印，复印件；  v.影印，复印
mean_en: a paper copy of a document, picture, etc., that is made with a special machine (called a copier or photocopier)
sentence: I asked the secretary to make a photocopy for me because I don't know how to use the machine.
sentence_trans: 我让秘书帮我影印一份文件，因为我不知道怎么用复印机。
word_etyma: photo照片+copy复制 → 影印 v.影印
